Market today: Inflation fears are back in focus, driving Treasury yields up. This is the real driver for your tech/chip heavy book, especially with margin.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -53.11% and SPAL is a TRIM at -37.53%. Both are leveraged ETFs that decay, and your margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 2-year Treasury yield, as it's reacting to inflation concerns.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the rising yield environment.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its -53.11% loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Evaluate reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF due to its -37.53% loss and decay.
QQQ: The scanner shows a BUY setup with entry 719.48-718.28 and stop 715.61. Monitor this level.
